1: Unidentified armed assailants storm a CIA safe house, cutting down elite operatives in seconds until only gunfire echoes through the smoke.
2: The sole survivor is a rookie agent who has guarded the house for a year, and his first guest happens to be a legendary spy who betrayed the CIA.
3: In Cape Town, South Africa, CIA agent Matt Weston has a French girlfriend named Ana, though she has no idea what he really does for a living.
4: Weston's job is to babysit a safe house with no guests, spending his days in the empty building just waiting for the phone to ring.
5: His boss, Barlow, always gives him the same answer, leaving Weston to spend another day staring out the window.
6: At that same hour on the streets of Cape Town, Tobin Frost—a top operative who turned his back on the CIA nine years ago—sets out to make a covert deal.
7: After receiving a tiny microchip from his former MI6 colleague Wade, Frost stops by the restroom only to be ambushed by an attacker.
8: The moment Frost subdues the attacker and steps back out, sniper fire rains down, forcing him to drag Wade along as they flee.
9: The gunmen ram the car carrying Wade and Frost, sparking a fierce chase right through the middle of downtown.
10: With the mercenary Vargas and his men closing in relentlessly, Frost makes the unexpected choice of walking straight into the U.S. consulate.
11: Earlier in the escape, Frost had dragged Wade into a crowd of protesters packing the streets to blend in.
12: As Vargas pushes through the crowd in pursuit, Frost slips past a cafe and ducks into an alleyway.
13: CIA headquarters in the U.S. is thrown into an uproar as the notorious traitor who spent nine years selling intelligence to foreign nations turns himself in right before operations chief Linklater and Deputy Director Whitford.
14: Without putting up any resistance, Frost lets the consulate guards take his mugshot and fingerprints.
15: Back in the dimly lit safe house, Weston kills time alone with his earphones in.
16: When Ana calls, all Weston can tell her is that he will be coming home late again tonight.
17: An extraction team lands on the tarmac in the dead of night under orders from headquarters to wrap up the operation within twelve hours.
18: That night, Weston's safe house finally receives its first guest when Tobin Frost is dragged in with a hood over his head.
19: Extraction team leader Kiefer shuts off the surveillance cameras and immediately begins waterboarding him.
20: As water pours over the wet towel covering Frost's face, Weston watches on the monitor before turning his head away.
21: Just then, the front gate cameras catch a group of heavily armed men approaching.
22: The guard at the front gate goes down, and the gunmen push their way all the way up to the second-floor hallway.
23: Flashbangs detonate and turn the safe house into pure chaos in an instant, taking down Kiefer's team one by one.
24: Still tied to his chair, Frost calmly tries to rattle Weston.
25: In the end, Weston drags Frost out of the safe house and shoves him into the trunk of a car.
26: Passing Kiefer's fallen body, Weston hauls Frost toward the emergency exit.
27: Through a crowded market alley, Weston keeps his gun aimed at Frost and forces him toward a car.
28: Speeding through the city to escape Vargas and his men, Weston reports in to headquarters by phone, only to be ordered to lay low.
29: After a high-speed highway chase that shatters the rear window with bullets, Weston finally shakes off his pursuers, though his car is left in ruins.
30: The chase ends with the car crashing, leaving both men slumped motionless behind the shattered windshield.
31: Headquarters even begins digging into Weston's background as an orphaned, Yale-educated agent, realizing that this rookie is now the only person they can trust.
32: While Weston searches for the keys to a new car in a parking garage, Frost watches him closely from the back seat.
33: Once the two of them steal a new car, Frost talks incessantly to Weston behind the wheel.
34: As Weston drives, Frost tells him to think carefully about who could have known the location of the safe house.
35: Suspicion begins to take root at headquarters as well, where Linklater becomes convinced there is a mole on the inside.
36: At the same time somewhere in Cape Town, Vargas and his crew check their weapons and prepare for their next assault.
37: Meanwhile, hiding out in a rundown motel, Weston uses a payphone to call Ana, unaware that a mysterious car is already parked outside her home.
38: In the shabby room, Frost sits handcuffed to a pipe while Weston paces by the window.
39: Having overheard the phone call, Frost strikes right at Weston's most vulnerable spot.
40: Putting down the receiver, Weston leans his head against the wall.
41: Back at headquarters, Whitford, Barlow, and Linklater wait anxiously for Weston's call.
42: When Weston barely manages to reach headquarters, his boss Barlow instructs him to head to a new safe house and reveals that a GPS device is hidden in a stadium locker.
43: At a stadium packed with crowds for a soccer match, Weston handcuffs Frost and heads toward the lockers.
44: In the stadium parking lot that night, Frost tells Weston to walk away from this whole affair.
45: Right in the middle of the crowd, Frost suddenly shouts that he is being kidnapped.
46: As the police pin Weston down, Frost lies on the ground and bursts out laughing.
47: Using a security room monitor, Weston locates the infirmary where Frost was taken, only to see on the screen that a commotion has already broken out inside.
48: Seizing the moment, Weston knocks out a police officer, changes into his uniform, and goes after Frost.
49: After taking down a security guard and stealing his uniform, Weston blends into the stadium crowd.
50: When Weston aims his gun at Frost running out into the plaza, the crowd screams and scatters in panic.
51: In the end, however, Frost disarms Weston and forces him to his knees.
52: Frost disappears aboard a subway train, leaving Weston to lose him once again.
53: Headquarters uncovers the identity of Wade, the man Frost met, learning he was a former MI6 agent under internal investigation for trafficking intelligence.
54: Standing before a bathroom mirror to wash the blood off his face, Weston looks completely exhausted.
55: With two police officers dead at the stadium, the news broadcasts Weston as a murder suspect, and headquarters orders him to stand down for good.
56: Hearing the exact words Frost had warned him about, Weston's expression hardens.
57: Meanwhile, Frost retrieves the microchip hidden in his body and shaves his head to alter his appearance.
58: Meeting Ana at the train station, Weston finally confesses everything to her.
59: Right in the middle of the station, Weston presses a ticket to Johannesburg into Ana's hand.
60: After sending a tearful Ana away, Weston decides to track down Frost on his own.
61: Weston boards a train bound for Langa, watching the unfamiliar shantytown flash past the window.
62: Secretly logging into the CIA server from an internet cafe, Weston identifies a forger whom Frost is likely to visit.
63: In the township of Langa, Frost visits his old friend Carlos to ask for a new passport.
64: Carlos welcomes Frost warmly, though worry lingers in his eyes.
65: While Carlos crafts a fake passport in his dark workshop, Frost peers closely at a computer screen.
66: From headquarters, Linklater and Barlow fly directly to Cape Town, with Barlow curiously defending Weston along the way.
67: At that moment, Vargas and his men storm Carlos's house, unleashing a hail of gunfire aimed at Frost.
68: As gunshots ring out, Carlos's family ducks behind a sofa while Frost flees onto the roof.
69: In a relentless chase across the dark shantytown, Weston doggedly pursues Frost.
70: Just as Frost tries to drive off in a truck, Weston steps out to block his path.
71: Their vehicle crashes into another car, and a fierce brawl breaks out in the dark.
72: Suddenly, a knife-wielding assailant lunges at Weston, and after a brutal struggle, Weston hears a shocking confession from the dying man's lips.
73: As the attacker collapses, Frost watches the entire scene from behind a wall.
74: Having just landed at the airport, Barlow and Linklater hear news of the shootout in Langa and begin to move separately.
75: Hiding inside a pharmacy to tend to each other's wounds, Frost opens up about why he left the CIA.
76: Weston takes Frost to an isolated farmhouse safe house, where the caretaker agent, Keller, greets them.
77: Predicting that Weston will head to the farmhouse safe house, Barlow tells Linklater to meet him there.
78: Pressing his gun to Keller's forehead, Weston only lowers his weapon after verifying the authentication code.
79: After chaining Frost to a pipe, Keller notifies headquarters of the guest's arrival.
80: Driving toward the farm at that very hour, Barlow receives a report that what Frost possesses is a microchip.
81: Having finished reporting to headquarters, Weston sits down across from Keller to catch his breath.
82: The moment Weston turns around to get some coffee, Keller lunges at him, sparking a bloody fight to the death across a floor littered with broken glass until Weston barely manages to bring him down.
83: Vargas storms in right after, but Frost steps in to save Weston.
84: Finally, Frost reveals the truth that this file on the microchip was the entire reason he came to Cape Town.
85: With Weston bleeding from a gunshot wound, Frost prepares to leave him behind.
86: When the unconscious Weston opens his eyes, he finds his boss Barlow sitting right beside him.
87: Yet as Barlow persistently questions him about the whereabouts of the file rather than Frost, Weston realizes who the true traitor was all along.
88: At that very instant, Frost returns and another shootout erupts, ending with Weston finally shooting the traitor Barlow while Frost also collapses from a gunshot wound.
89: As Vargas searches the house and closes in, Frost fires at him from his hiding spot.
90: With Frost slumped bleeding in the hallway, Weston crawls over to his side.
91: Right there beside Weston, the legendary spy closes his eyes for the last time.
92: Weston stands alone before the flames now that everything is over.
93: When Weston returns to headquarters, Deputy Director Whitford offers him a promotion in exchange for burying the truth.
94: Upon walking out of the office, however, Weston leaks Frost's files straight to the press.
95: While intelligence agencies around the world are thrown into turmoil, Weston heads to Paris to find Ana, who recognizes him from her seat at a cafe.
96: That was Universal's *Safe House*, a film highlighted by the tense chemistry between stars Denzel Washington and Ryan Reynolds.
97: Frost says that if you tell a lie every day it becomes the truth, so leave a comment sharing whether you would have chosen the promotion or the truth if you were in Weston's shoes.
